newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 10 trln lire BTP, CCTs.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 10 trln lire BTP, CCTs.

text.p: The Italian treasury is expected on average to issue 10 trillion lire worth of medium to long-term paper at its mid-month auctions against 6.0 trillion lire maturing, a Reuter poll of economists showed.
The Treasury will announce the amounts on Friday.

On Wednesday it said it would open a new January 1, 2004 floating rate certificate (CCT) paying a first coupon of 3.45 percent at its January 15 auction. The previous CCT paid a first coupon of 3.80 percent.

The Treasury also said it would re-open existing three, five and 10-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) offerings. The 10-year BTP auction will be on January 15 and the three and five-year BTP auction on January 16.

Economists said the Treasury's issue strategy remained that of keeping an orderly control of maturing paper. "For this mid-month auction the Treasury will issue more paper than that maturing while at the beginning of January with a large amount maturing it did the opposite," one noted.
